name: Bethphage
overview: Bethphage is identified in the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke as a village located on the Mount of Olives near Jerusalem. It serves as a significant geographical marker where Jesus sent two of His disciples as He approached the city, highlighting its role in the events leading up to His triumphal entry. This setting underscores Bethphage's proximity to key locations in Jesus' final journey, emphasizing its place in the narrative of His fulfillment of Messianic prophecy.
